mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 5.0% and inflation is accelerating (CPIAUCSL 3-month change > 0.5%), it signals a tightening cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with accelerating inflation
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% AND CPIAUCSL 3-month change > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), the S&P 500 tends to have positive 20-day forward returns due to strong economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth (INDPRO 3-month change) falls below 0.5%, it signals a slowdown in supply that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO 3-month change < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are falling (HOUST 3-month change < -0.5%) and retail sales (RSAFS) are declining (RSAFS 3-month change < -0.5%), it signals a demand slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST 3-month change < -0.5% AND RSAFS 3-month change < -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (measured as the 6-month change) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where the 6-month change in UNRATE is negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) rises above 110, it signals strong supply growth that leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO > 110.
